name: Island, west end — the closed end
prompt: The first reference image is an exact 3D massing model of the café with every fixture labelled; the second is the dimensioned floor plan it was built from. Keep every object exactly where the model puts it, at its size: the island is two parallel counters with an open walkway between them, the espresso machine, grinders, juicer and sink on the back counter, the pastry case and till on the front counter; the back wall is shelving with the menu board centred over a low shelf and a door at the far left, with no counter against it; three open chillers fill the left wall under a lightbox sign; open snack shelving fills the right wall. The third reference is the approved overview render of the same café: match its materials, colours and lighting, and render the view described below from inside that exact space. kōra is a small grab-and-go café in Delhi. The room is a clean rectangle, 32 feet wide and 19 feet deep, with a full-height glass front onto the street and a 12-by-8-foot island bar in the middle. Materials: pale white-oak timber shelving with thin matte-black steel frames, fluted white-oak counter fronts, honed pale-limestone counter tops, warm off-white lime-plaster walls, pale oak-look porcelain plank floor, one deep forest-green accent used only on the fascia, the outdoor chairs and small signs. Signage is black capital letters on white backlit panels. Light is warm white, 3000 K, from LED strips under every shelf and three opal-glass pendants over the island; daylight comes in through the glass front. Everything is tidy and stocked: rows of clear bottles of cold-pressed juice in orange, red, green and gold, fruit cups, kraft snack bags, white coffee cups. No people unless stated, no clutter, no rustic props, no coffee sacks, no exposed brick, no neon, no readable text anywhere except the signs named in the view. A photorealistic interior photograph of the short end of the island bar, seen straight on from the left aisle. An 8-foot-wide, waist-high panel of vertical fluted white oak under a pale-limestone top, closing the end of the island. Mounted on the panel at eye level, a plain white square tile with a thin black border, blank, and below it a small black-on-white sign reading BRING YOUR OWN CUP. On the counter top above, a stack of white reusable cups. To the left, the lit grab-and-go chillers recede toward the glass front; to the right, the pantry wall. Warm light, three pendants visible above the island, 35mm, 2:3 portrait, natural colour, fine grain.
